clearance.method: Transformed full vegetation bounds versus actual rock bounds in world XZ,8cm padding

flowerClearance.method: Transformed full vegetation bounds versus actual rock bounds in world XZ,8cm padding

alpine.physicalGrass: Existing curved indexed grass geometry; low green clumps, no gold cards
alpine.functionalTrees: Existing conifer architecture, field-dependent height/width, no local occurrence assertion

coverage.mask: actual alpha-tested vegetation silhouette, original geometry; isolated from ground and nonvegetation

limitations: Metrics flag potential failures; they cannot establish artistic quality.
Coverage mask omits terrain occlusion; near-black statistics include legitimate shadows.
Faceting, continuity and conspicuous repetition require vision inspection; no RGB-only artistic approval.
